name: Non-Product State Implies State Readout
description: Theorem: if SZ is not a Cartesian product and RZ is properly aligned projective, then SZ = OZ and RZ = ID(SZ).

elements.text: If SZ is not a Cartesian product and RZ is properly aligned projective, then SZ = OZ.
If SZ is not a Cartesian product and RZ is properly aligned projective, then Z has state readout (RZ = ID(SZ)).
